panels.label: (b) Inter-stage Migration

content.key_idea: Parcae recovers from preemptions with three migration strategies over the same instance grid: swap in a same-stage peer (intra-stage), reassign a spare instance to a different stage (inter-stage), or reshuffle every surviving instance into a new pipeline layout.
content.reading_order: left to right within each dashed panel: the before-migration grid with preempted instances crossed out, into the purple migration-rule box, to the after-migration grid and its new D/P configuration and any idle instances.

encoding.line_style_means: solid black arrows trace which surviving instance is re-routed to which stage slot; the rule box's own notation distinguishes a plain → (same-stage swap) from a ⇒ (cross-stage or whole-pipeline reassignment)
encoding.state_means: before vs after migration is told apart by the D=/P= configuration line under each grid and by which instances are struck out (before) versus shown solid or hatched-idle (after)
encoding.marker_means: a red X crosses out a preempted instance; a green dashed hatched box marks instances left idle after migration; no numbered path markers are used
encoding.emphasis: repeating the identical before/rule-box/after template in all three dashed panels, changing only which instances are struck out and how the rule box remaps them, isolates exactly what each migration strategy does differently
reusable_patterns: a grid of stage x replica cubes with preempted members crossed out, fed through a labelled rule box, producing an after-grid plus a dashed hatched box of any newly idle members

evidence: Parcae uses three migration strategies (Figure 6) to handle preemptions: intra-stage, inter-stage, and pipeline migration.
when instances a and f are preempted, Parcae can replace f by moving b to the second pipeline
Illustrations of different migration strategies over a 3×4 parallel configuration facing 2 preempted instances.

summary: Figure 6 compares Parcae's three migration strategies for recovering from preempted training instances, applying each to the same 3-pipeline, 4-stage (D=3, P=4) starting grid. In (a) Intra-stage Migration, instances a and f are preempted; Parcae moves b, which holds the same stage-2 shard as f, into f's slot, completing one pipeline while c and d fall idle. In (b) Inter-stage Migration, b and f are preempted instead; since no same-stage peer is free, e is reassigned from stage 1 to stage 2, again completing one pipeline and idling g and h. In (c) Pipeline Migration, b and c are preempted; rather than filling a single gap, Parcae reshuffles all ten surviving instances into two fresh pipelines with a deeper pipeline-parallel degree (P=5), leaving nothing idle. Each panel's purple rule box states which instances are lost, which become idle, and the migration mapping used.
summary_zh: 图6在同一3x4网格上对比Parcae的三种迁移策略：级内迁移用同阶段实例b替补被抢占的f；级间迁移让e跨阶段补位；流水线迁移则重排全部存活实例，得到P=5的新配置且无空闲。
